title: Line Powered Mobile Column Lift System
description_text: Line Powered Mobile Column Lift System comprising four (4) individual columns, designed for lifting large vehicles such as semi-trucks and buses. It provides a total lifting capacity of 72,000 lbs(18,000 lbs per column). This system operates on 208-230/190V, 50-60 Hz, 3-Phasepower (low voltage option). It features intuitive push-button controls, multiple automatic safety locks, and is ALI/ETL Certified to meet ANSI/ALI ALCTV safety standards. Designed for portability and versatility in vehicle maintenance, it supports SINGLE, PAIR, or TEAM operation modes.
